business.title: Business ki jaankari
business.lead: Yeh aapke bills par chhapti hai. Purane bills par wahi jaankari rehti hai jiske saath woh chhape the.

features.title: Features

security.staffIdleHint: Itne minute istemaal na hone par staff ka login band ho jaata hai.

forgot.title: Password bhool gaye?
forgot.lead: Email se naya password banane ka link paayein, ya signup ke samay rakhi recovery key use karein.

email.lead: Hum naya password chunne ka link email karenge. Yeh sirf pakke kiye gaye email par aata hai.
email.sent: Agar {{email}} ka pakka kiya hua account hai, to link bhej diya gaya hai. Yeh 30 minute tak chalega.
email.noEmail: Kuch minute mein email nahi aaya? Spam dekhein, ya apni recovery key use karein.

key.lead: Recovery key se password turant badal jaata hai. Har key ek hi baar chalti hai, isliye phir aapko nayi key milegi.
key.label: Recovery key
key.hint: 32 akshar aur ank, jaise aapne likhe the. Dash aur khaali jagah se fark nahi padta.
key.wrong: Email aur recovery key match nahi karte. Dono check karein aur phir koshish karein.
key.done: Aapka password badal gaya aur aap har jagah se logout ho gaye. Purani key ab nahi chalegi: yeh nayi key sambhaal kar rakhein.

forgot.tooMany: Bahut zyada koshishein. {{time}} par phir koshish karein.
forgot.failed: Bheja nahi ja saka. Connection check karein aur phir koshish karein.

resetPage.title: Naya password chunein
resetPage.lead: Iske baad aap har computer se logout ho jaayenge, aur naye password se login karenge.
resetPage.done: Aapka password badal gaya. Aap har computer se logout ho gaye hain.
resetPage.invalid: Yeh link purana ho gaya ya pehle hi use ho chuka hai. Link 30 minute tak, ek baar chalta hai.
resetPage.failed: Save nahi ho saka. Connection check karein aur phir koshish karein.

confirmPage.title: Apna email pakka karein
confirmPage.lead: Yeh email pakka karne ke liye button dabaayein. Phir password bhoolne par aap email se naya password bana sakenge.
confirmPage.invalid: Yeh link purana ho gaya ya pehle hi use ho chuka hai. Naye link ke liye login karein aur banner par "Phir bhejein" dabaayein.
confirmPage.failed: Pakka nahi ho saka. Connection check karein aur phir koshish karein.

emailBanner.label: Email pakka karna
emailBanner.body: Apna email pakka karein: humne aapko ek link bheja hai. Tab tak bhoola hua password sirf recovery key se badal sakta hai.
emailBanner.limited: Is demo mein email sirf humare jaanche hue patton par jaata hai. Email na aaye to apni recovery key sambhaal kar rakhein: waapas aane ka raasta wahi hai.
emailBanner.sent: Bhej diya. Link 7 din tak chalega.
emailBanner.tooMany: Bahut zyada koshishein. {{time}} par phir koshish karein.
emailBanner.failed: Bheja nahi ja saka. Connection check karein aur phir koshish karein.
